Anti-Corruption Bureau Raids Excise Superintendent for Disproportionate Assets

The Anti-Corruption Bureau (ACB) has conducted raids on Excise Superintendent Malla Reddy and his associates. The raids are reportedly in connection with a disproportionate assets case. This action by the ACB highlights ongoing efforts to investigate alleged corruption within government departments.
